topics.name: AI Agents & Infrastructure
topics.summary: Advances in AI agents, from autonomous workplace assistants to medical diagnostic systems, are fueling massive investments in computing infrastructure and driving rapid user adoption across various sectors.

topics.name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection
topics.summary: Global digital infrastructure faces increasing threats from hyper-volumetric DDoS attacks and evolving surveillance technologies, highlighting the critical need for enhanced cybersecurity measures and data protection.

topics.name: Space & Scientific Exploration
topics.summary: Significant progress is being made in space exploration with new telescopic observations and lunar mission planning, alongside breakthroughs in fundamental scientific research.

topics.name: Developer Innovations & Ecosystem
topics.summary: The developer landscape is being transformed by AI-powered tools that enhance coding, testing, and automation, supported by an expanding open-source ecosystem and new approaches to developer workflows.
